# Welcome! {.unnumbered}

Welcome to the Open Soil Spectral Library (OSSL) manual!

The OSSL is a public and growing dataset that is compiled by the [Soil Spectroscopy for Global Good](https://soilspectroscopy.org/) initiative.

A [peer-reviewed and open-access publication](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0296545) is available for additional reference.

### 📖 Getting Started & Overview
- [About](#sec-about): Team, contributors, resources, and citation guidelines.
- [Soil Spectroscopy](#sec-soilspec): Overview of spectroscopy, predictive modeling, instruments, and software.

### 💾 Data & Models
- [Soil Spectral Libraries](#sec-libraries): Individualized libraries integrated into the OSSL.
- [Database Description](#sec-db-desc): Variable definitions, schema, and data types.
- [Database Access](#sec-db-access): Download options and access instructions.
- [Neospectra Library](#sec-neospectra): Featured NIR dataset developed under SS4GG.
- [Predictive Models](#sec-prediction-models): Calibrated spectral models.

### 🛠️ Tools, Tutorials & Research
- [Online Tools](#sec-web-services): User-friendly, open web applications.
- [Hands-on Tutorial](#sec-tutorial): Step-by-step guide on predictive modeling.
- [Scientific Publications](#sec-publications): Research papers from the team and collaborators.
- [References](#sec-references): Cited literature.
